question: I downloaded a custom 30W nvpmodel.conf from the NVIDIA Power Estimator for my P3767-0001. Add it as ID 8 NAME 30W_CUSTOM and make it the boot default with /jetson-customize-nvpmodel.
ground_truth: Resolve <active-sku>, verify the file exists, apply the Overlay edit recipe, insert the new POWER_MODEL block, edit PM_CONFIG DEFAULT, propagate to siblings, commit, and deploy via /jetson-promote-image then /jetson-flash-image.
expected_behavior: Resolve <active-sku> and verify the file exists

question: My GPU MAX_FREQ edit in nvpmodel doesn't take effect. What's the right fix?
ground_truth: Frequency values must come from the kernel's available_frequencies table; a value outside the table gets silently rounded. Re-run the Power Estimator and apply the fresh conf via the Overlay edit recipe.
expected_behavior: Re-run the Power Estimator for a fresh conf
